name: chime-sdk-voice
description: The Amazon Chime SDK telephony APIs in this section enable developers to create PSTN calling solutions that use Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connectors, and Amazon Chime SDK SIP media applications.

subcommands.name: associate-phone-numbers-with-voice-connector
subcommands.description: Associates phone numbers with the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: associate-phone-numbers-with-voice-connector-group
subcommands.description: Associates phone numbers with the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-phone-number
subcommands.description: Moves phone numbers into the Deletion queue.

subcommands.name: batch-update-phone-number
subcommands.description: Updates phone number product types, calling names, or phone number names.

subcommands.name: create-phone-number-order
subcommands.description: Creates an order for phone numbers to be provisioned.

subcommands.name: create-proxy-session
subcommands.description: Creates a proxy session for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector for the specified participant phone numbers.

subcommands.name: create-sip-media-application
subcommands.description: Creates a SIP media application.

subcommands.name: create-sip-media-application-call
subcommands.description: Creates an outbound call to a phone number from the phone number specified in the request, and it invokes the endpoint of the specified sipMediaApplicationId.

subcommands.name: create-sip-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a SIP rule, which can be used to run a SIP media application as a target for a specific trigger type.

subcommands.name: create-voice-connector
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: create-voice-connector-group
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group under the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: create-voice-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a voice profile, which consists of an enrolled user and their latest voice print.

subcommands.name: create-voice-profile-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a voice profile domain, a collection of voice profiles, their voice prints, and encrypted enrollment audio.

subcommands.name: delete-phone-number
subcommands.description: Moves the specified phone number into the Deletion queue.

subcommands.name: delete-proxy-session
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified proxy session from the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-sip-media-application
subcommands.description: Deletes a SIP media application.

subcommands.name: delete-sip-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a SIP rule.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-emergency-calling-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the emergency calling details from the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-external-systems-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the external systems configuration for a Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-group
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-origination
subcommands.description: Deletes the origination settings for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-proxy
subcommands.description: Deletes the proxy configuration from the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-streaming-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a Voice Connector's streaming configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-termination
subcommands.description: Deletes the termination settings for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-connector-termination-credentials
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified SIP credentials used by your equipment to authenticate during call termination.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes a voice profile, including its voice print and enrollment data.

subcommands.name: delete-voice-profile-domain
subcommands.description: Deletes all voice profiles in the domain.

subcommands.name: disassociate-phone-numbers-from-voice-connector
subcommands.description: Disassociates the specified phone numbers from the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: disassociate-phone-numbers-from-voice-connector-group
subcommands.description: Disassociates the specified phone numbers from the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group.

subcommands.name: get-global-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves the global settings for the Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connectors in an AWS account.

subcommands.name: get-phone-number
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified phone number ID, such as associations, capabilities, and product type.

subcommands.name: get-phone-number-order
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified phone number order, such as the order creation timestamp, phone numbers in E.164 format, product type, and order status.

subcommands.name: get-phone-number-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves the phone number settings for the administrator's AWS account, such as the default outbound calling name.

subcommands.name: get-proxy-session
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified proxy session details for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-sip-media-application
subcommands.description: Retrieves the information for a SIP media application, including name, AWS Region, and endpoints.

subcommands.name: get-sip-media-application-alexa-skill-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the Alexa Skill configuration for the SIP media application.

subcommands.name: get-sip-media-application-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the logging configuration for the specified SIP media application.

subcommands.name: get-sip-rule
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a SIP rule, such as the rule ID, name, triggers, and target endpoints.

subcommands.name: get-speaker-search-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of the specified speaker search task.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector, such as timestamps,name, outbound host, and encryption requirements.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-emergency-calling-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the emergency calling configuration details for the specified Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-external-systems-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets information about an external systems configuration for a Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group, such as timestamps,name, and associated VoiceConnectorItems.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the logging configuration settings for the specified Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-origination
subcommands.description: Retrieves the origination settings for the specified Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-proxy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the proxy configuration details for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-streaming-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the streaming configuration details for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-termination
subcommands.description: Retrieves the termination setting details for the specified Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-connector-termination-health
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the last time a SIP OPTIONS ping was received from your SIP infrastructure for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: get-voice-profile
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of the specified voice profile.

subcommands.name: get-voice-profile-domain
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of the specified voice profile domain.

subcommands.name: get-voice-tone-analysis-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a voice tone analysis task.

subcommands.name: list-available-voice-connector-regions
subcommands.description: Lists the available AWS Regions in which you can create an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: list-phone-number-orders
subcommands.description: Lists the phone numbers for an administrator's Amazon Chime SDK account.

subcommands.name: list-phone-numbers
subcommands.description: Lists the phone numbers for the specified Amazon Chime SDK account, Amazon Chime SDK user, Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector, or Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group.

subcommands.name: list-proxy-sessions
subcommands.description: Lists the proxy sessions for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: list-sip-media-applications
subcommands.description: Lists the SIP media applications under the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-sip-rules
subcommands.description: Lists the SIP rules under the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-supported-phone-number-countries
subcommands.description: Lists the countries that you can order phone numbers from.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags in a given resource.

subcommands.name: list-voice-connector-groups
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector groups in the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-voice-connector-termination-credentials
subcommands.description: Lists the SIP credentials for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: list-voice-connectors
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connectors in the administrators AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-voice-profile-domains
subcommands.description: Lists the specified voice profile domains in the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-voice-profiles
subcommands.description: Lists the voice profiles in a voice profile domain.

subcommands.name: put-sip-media-application-alexa-skill-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the Alexa Skill configuration for the SIP media application.

subcommands.name: put-sip-media-application-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the logging configuration for the specified SIP media application.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-emergency-calling-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a Voice Connector's emergency calling configuration.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-external-systems-configuration
subcommands.description: Adds an external systems configuration to a Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a Voice Connector's logging configuration.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-origination
subcommands.description: Updates a Voice Connector's origination settings.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-proxy
subcommands.description: Puts the specified proxy configuration to the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-streaming-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a Voice Connector's streaming configuration settings.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-termination
subcommands.description: Updates a Voice Connector's termination settings.

subcommands.name: put-voice-connector-termination-credentials
subcommands.description: Updates a Voice Connector's termination credentials.

subcommands.name: restore-phone-number
subcommands.description: Restores a deleted phone number.

subcommands.name: search-available-phone-numbers
subcommands.description: Searches the provisioned phone numbers in an organization.

subcommands.name: start-speaker-search-task
subcommands.description: Starts a speaker search task.

subcommands.name: start-voice-tone-analysis-task
subcommands.description: Starts a voice tone analysis task.

subcommands.name: stop-speaker-search-task
subcommands.description: Stops a speaker search task.

subcommands.name: stop-voice-tone-analysis-task
subcommands.description: Stops a voice tone analysis task.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a tag to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-global-settings
subcommands.description: Updates global settings for the Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connectors in an AWS account.

subcommands.name: update-phone-number
subcommands.description: Updates phone number details, such as product type, calling name, or phone number name for the specified phone number ID.

subcommands.name: update-phone-number-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the phone number settings for the administrator's AWS account, such as the default outbound calling name.

subcommands.name: update-proxy-session
subcommands.description: Updates the specified proxy session details, such as voice or SMS capabilities.

subcommands.name: update-sip-media-application
subcommands.description: Updates the details of the specified SIP media application.

subcommands.name: update-sip-media-application-call
subcommands.description: Invokes the AWS Lambda function associated with the SIP media application and transaction ID in an update request.

subcommands.name: update-sip-rule
subcommands.description: Updates the details of the specified SIP rule.

subcommands.name: update-voice-connector
subcommands.description: Updates the details for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector.

subcommands.name: update-voice-connector-group
subcommands.description: Updates the settings for the specified Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector group.

subcommands.name: update-voice-profile
subcommands.description: Updates the specified voice profile’s voice print and refreshes its expiration timestamp.

subcommands.name: update-voice-profile-domain
subcommands.description: Updates the settings for the specified voice profile domain.

subcommands.name: validate-e911-address
subcommands.description: Validates an address to be used for 911 calls made with Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connectors.
